start.text: (Asleep against the window, then not.) Sorry - was I talking? Double shift. Hebbal side, the new wing. Strange cases, same story every time: fever, then the light hurts their eyes, then they stop talking.

choices.text: Sleep. I'll wake you at Cubbon.

seasonal.text: Seasonal. The ward says seasonal, the paper says seasonal. Seasonal doesn't make a grown man scared of a tube light. (She closes her eyes.) Wake me at the park, no?

sleep.text: Bless you. (Gone in three seconds. Her ID badge turns over: a hospital crest, a name, HEBBAL in red.)

again.text: (Asleep. Properly, this time. The badge swings with the bus.)
